model.title: RISE Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Jim Banks (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would require colleges to provide students with disabilities and their families with better access to information about disability support services, campus accessibility, and other resources needed to choose and succeed at the right institution.
